title: Phase 7B energy confirmation: direct measured inference energy of the frozen Phase 7B SimpleCNN models
frozen_rule: Written before any qualification or comparison data. Nothing below changes after this file is committed.
question: Does the frozen Phase 7B PPO-Structured SimpleCNN [2,2,2,5] use less measured CPU inference energy than the recovered dense SimpleCNN?
positioning: Separate measurement study. It does not modify the frozen Phase 7B experiment, its verdicts (GREEN-SUCCESS = NO, accuracy -1.12 pp) or its 3% pilot criterion, which failed and stays failed.

models.integrity: file SHA-256 and state-dict SHA-256 must match the Phase 7B / 7A freeze records (checkpoint_verification.json) before any measurement; no training or fine-tuning

backend: Intel RAPL package energy via the Windows Energy Meter Interface (PDH Energy Meter(RAPL_Package0_PKG) Energy counter), read immediately before and after each block; no TDP, estimate or surrogate. No external meter is available.

conditions.machine: same laptop, Intel Core i7-1260P, Windows 11
conditions.threads: 1 intra-op, 1 inter-op (OMP/MKL env set before torch import, torch.set_num_*_threads)
conditions.model_loading: excluded (all models loaded and hash-checked before the soak)

workload.soak: continuous inference of the run's first model for 180 s before the first block (fixed thermal conditioning)
workload.rationale: The 2026-11-03 Phase 7B pilot showed block power falling within each process (first block highest), and the smoke test of this script (Dense only, n = 2,000, not analysed) showed CPU 2 settling from about 203% to about 134% of nominal clock during the soak; a fixed soak is added for that transient. N = 200,000 and the soak length are fixed now and are not tuned on qualification data.

recorded_per_block: latency median/mean/p95/IQR (per-inference perf_counter_ns) and wall-clock mean
system-wide CPU load during the block
% Processor Performance of CPU 2 and _Total during the block
affinity, threads, power plan per run

validity.gate_before_each_run: AC, Balanced plan, system load <= 15% over 5 s; otherwise wait (nothing measured) up to 30 min, then STOP
validity.void_run: a run with any block whose system-wide load during the block > 15% (this process alone is about 6.25%) or that ends off AC is void, kept in _raw/<stage>/void/, and repeated
validity.never: runs are never voided, kept or repeated on the basis of energy or latency values
validity.max_voids: more than 3 void runs in one stage -> STOP

qualification.design: Dense only: 3 fresh runs x 2 blocks = 6 blocks, full workload
qualification.criterion: CV (sample SD / mean) of the 6 Dense E_1000 values <= 3% -> qualified
qualification.attempts: one; not qualified -> STOP ('Direct energy confirmation remains unresolved because the available measurement setup did not satisfy the stability requirement'); the limit is not relaxed and the qualification is not rerun
qualification.relation_to_old_criterion: the old Phase 7B pilot criterion (CV <= 3%) failed (CV 4.01%) and remains failed; this is a new, separately defined qualification of a new protocol with the same 3% limit

sessions.content: Dense and Phase 7B PPO once each per session (paired)
sessions.order: balanced: 5 sessions Dense-first and 5 PPO-first, assigned by numpy default_rng(20261103).permutation([0]*5+[1]*5)

metrics.energy: E_1000 = package J / N x 1000 per block; J/inference = package J / N
metrics.saving_per_session: 100 x (1 - E_PPO / E_Dense) within the session
metrics.latency: median per-inference latency per block (primary); speed-up per session = L_Dense / L_PPO
metrics.edp: per session (J/inference x wall-clock latency per inference)_PPO / (same)_Dense; Dense = 1.0
metrics.summaries: median (primary), mean, SD and CV over sessions for each model; per-session savings

statistics.paired: exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test on E_PPO - E_Dense (one-sided H1: PPO lower; two-sided also reported), exact sign test
statistics.t_test: not used: n = 10 and normality of the differences is not assessable; interpretation rests on consistency, magnitude and variability

noise_threshold: 2 x max(qualification CV, between-session CV of Dense E_1000), in percent

energy_confirmed.rule: YES only if all hold, else NO
energy_confirmed.2: E_PPO < E_Dense in >= 8 of the 10 sessions
energy_confirmed.4: leave-one-session-out: for every omitted session, the median saving of the remaining 9 > noise threshold and E_PPO < E_Dense in >= 7 of 9

secondary.when: only after the 10 primary sessions are complete and only if qualified
secondary.design: 5 fresh-process sessions, each with Dense, Phase 7B PPO, Uniform, LAMP and old PPO once, order numpy default_rng(20261104) permutation per session
secondary.use: descriptive only (per-session energy saving vs same-session Dense, latency); does not enter ENERGY-CONFIRMED

claims.if_yes: The frozen Phase 7B structured PPO model reduced parameter memory by 63.4%, MAC computation by 36.0%, and measured CPU inference energy relative to the dense model, while incurring a 1.12 percentage-point validation-accuracy reduction.
claims.if_no_energy_not_lower: The model reduced memory and MACs, but these reductions did not translate into lower measured operational energy under the evaluated CPU configuration.
claims.if_unstable: Direct energy confirmation remains unresolved because the available measurement setup did not satisfy the stability requirement.
